title.zh: 二元一次方程组 · 两条直线的交点
title.en: Simultaneous Equations · Where Two Lines Meet

description.zh: 两个一次方程的公共解是两条直线的交点，可用代入法或加减法算出；D=0 时无解或有无穷多解。仅限两个未知数。
description.en: The common solution of two linear equations is the crossing of two lines, found by substitution or elimination; D = 0 means no solution or infinitely many. Two unknowns only.

reason.zh: 每个一次方程画出来是一条直线，斜率相同的两条线平行（D = 0），斜率不同就必有一个交点。
reason.en: Each linear equation draws a line; equal slopes give parallel lines (D = 0) and different slopes always cross once.

title.zh: 两个方程什么时候有唯一解？
title.en: When do two equations have exactly one solution?

ask.zh: 两个一次方程的公共解是两条直线的交点——两条直线相交、平行、重合时，各有几个公共解？
ask.en: The common solution of two linear equations is where two lines cross — for crossing, parallel and coincident lines, how many common solutions are there?

ask.zh: 直线的斜率不同，相交情况怎样？斜率相同但截距不同呢？
ask.en: What happens when the lines have different slopes? Same slope but different intercepts?

reveal.zh: 斜率不同必相交于唯一解；斜率相同、截距不同则平行无解；斜率截距都相同则重合，有无穷多解。
reveal.en: Different slopes always cross at exactly one solution; same slope with different intercepts means parallel lines and no solution; same slope and intercept means coincident lines and infinitely many solutions.
